name: reminders
description: Set timed notifications and reminders delivered via Telegram.
summary: Set timed notifications and reminders. Supports 'in X minutes', 'in X hours', and specific delay amounts. Reminders are delivered via Telegram.

skills.description: Set a reminder to be delivered after a delay. The LLM should convert natural language like 'in 30 minutes' or 'in 2 hours' to a delayMinutes value.

message.description: What to remind the user about

delayMinutes.description: How many minutes from now to send the reminder

skills.description: Cancel a pending reminder by its ID.
